name: tmc-level-params
description: Level difficulty parameter harness for level designers: from a level range and Normal/Hard/ExHard counts, generate per-level totals, kinds, four-category split, targets, stacking, moving vehicles and duration from competitor mainline statistics, score the difficulty curve against the competitor, and finalize after an agent review.

interface.shortDescription: Generate per-level difficulty parameters for a batch of levels.
interface.longDescription: For level designers, not production. Input a level range and how many Normal, Hard and ExHard levels it holds. The harness places the difficulties, draws each level from real competitor levels near the same position, checks every level and the batch, scores eight difficulty pressures on one 0-100 scale, draws the composite and per-pressure curves next to the competitor levels with the same numbers (PNG), and lists flagged levels (out of range, big jumps, tiers not rising, a jumpy curve). The agent views the charts, re-draws flagged levels or keeps them with a written reason; finalize accepts only a review bound to the current parameters and weights, then writes level-params.json/csv/xlsx with the review record. Items are placeholders (building 1, prop 3); level production binds them to a theme. Needs Pillow; xlsx export needs xlsxwriter.
defaultPrompt: 生成 101–150 关的难度参数：Normal 35 关，Hard 10 关，ExHard 5 关。
把 120 关重抽一次，看综合难度曲线有没有变平。
复查这份 level-params.json 是否还通过全部检查。
